A few more steps to that rock and we'll rest. —How often I’ve sat here alone in thought, tormenting myself with prayer and fasting. Rich in hope, firm in faith, with tears and sighs and wringing of hands I tried to extort from the Lord an end to that plague. The crowd’s applause sounds to me now like mockery. If only you saw in my innermost soul how little that father and son deserve such fame! My father was an honorable man groping in darkness. In all good faith, he brooded on Nature and her sacred spheres, but always in his odd capricious way— never without honesty, never without sincerity of heart— but with tedious and fantastic means, and that was the problem. In the company of other adepts, he locked himself in the black kitchen of necromancy, where, with interminable recipes, he mixed the mutually incompatible. Patients died, and no one bothered to count the survivors. And so, armed with these hellish powders, we raged through the region, these mountains, these valleys, more devastating than even the plague! I myself gave the poison to thousands who withered away; and now I must live to hear the murderers praised to the skies.

@@U00261@@
But how can you let such matters trouble you? An honest man who works at the art he received from others, and does so punctiliously with a clear conscience—
translation:
@@U00259@@
再走几步就到那块岩石了，我们就休息了。 ——我有多少次独自坐在这里沉思，用祈祷和禁食来折磨自己。我怀着丰富的希望，坚定的信念，带着泪水、叹息和绞痛的双手，试图向主祈求结束这场瘟疫。人群的掌声现在对我来说就像是嘲笑。要是你能在我内心深处看到那对父子是多么不配得到这样的名声就好了！我的父亲是一位在黑暗中摸索的可敬的人。他满怀善意地沉思于自然和她的神圣领域，但总是以他奇怪的反复无常的方式——从来没有没有诚实，从来没有没有真诚的心——而是用乏味而荒诞的手段，这就是问题所在。在其他行家的陪伴下，他将自己锁在死灵术的黑色厨房里，在那里，他用没完没了的食谱，混合了互不相容的东西。病人死了，没有人费心去统计幸存者。于是，带着这些地狱般的粉末，我们肆虐了这个地区，这些山脉，这些山谷，其破坏性甚至比瘟疫还要严重！我亲自把毒药给了成千上万的枯萎者；现在我必须活着听到凶手被捧上天。

@@U00261@@
但你怎么能让这样的事情困扰你呢？一个诚实的人，致力于从别人那里得到的艺术，并且问心无愧地一丝不苟地这样做——
